description: Decimal ties in shortest-round-trip float emission (RFC §5.4.6). Each coefficient's exact binary value lies halfway between two shortest decimal candidates that both read back (705129328097.90625 between 705129328097.9062 and .9063); every binding writes the one with the even last digit, as Julia's Ryu, Python's repr, JavaScript's Number::toString and Go's strconv do. Covers plain and exponent layout and negative values. The last coefficient is 2^-24 = 5.9604644775390625e-8, a tie whose even candidate (...062) does not read back because the rounding interval below a power of two is half as wide, so ...063 is written.
